MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Dance from Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 Classical Music 3.3 Music and Dance in Socio-Cultural Cont and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Classical Music and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. C — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. C — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. C — The speed of the music

12. D — Red, blue, and yellow

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Contemporary Dance from Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 Classical Music 3.3 Music and Dance in Socio-Cultural Cont; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Classical Music; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
